card.name: Digit just before a zero in numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a number, mostly a year or ISO or ISBN number, where the next digit is a zero. It fires on the digit before the zero, such as the 9 in 1790 or the 0 in 2008.

modes.label: Years
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a four-digit year, right before a 0 or 0-heavy ending.

modes.label: Reference numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a standard or book number where a zero comes next.
